messages:
Maya (CS): Heads up — customer @AcmeReports hitting 400s from our API after last night's hotfix rollout (v3.2.1). They report tool calls failing when model tries to invoke the search tool. Error: "schema validation failed: missing required field 'metadata' for tool 'web_search'".
Alex (Support): Can you paste the exact API request they sent? Any request_id or example payload?
Maya (CS): Request id 0a1b2c3d, sent via our python SDK. Minimal repro they shared: user asks -> assistant tries tool 'web_search' -> 400. No region-specific note.
Alex (Support): Reproduced locally against staging variant: same 400. Response body: "tool_invocation: invalid_args, missing 'metadata'". Looks like the model selected a tool integration that expects an extra field.
Priya (Inference): Looking at rollout logs: the hotfix included a router change that allowed model-variant fallback to pick a smaller adapter for certain prompt shapes. That adapter (v-web-legacy) doesn't include the metadata envelope in tool glue. Canary metrics: tool-fail rate jumped from 0.6% -> 18% for search-related calls at 02:12 UTC.
Sam (Oncall): deploy-bot shows canary rollout completed at 02:10, spike aligns. @Jordan can we check the routing policy diff?
Jordan (SRE): confirmed — routing policy got an extra match for "short_prompt" that punts traffic to model v3.2-compact which uses a legacy tool schema. Diff snippet: 
```
- route: prefer model:v3.2
+ route: prefer model:v3.2, fallback model:v3.2-compact for prompt.length < 80
```
This was added in hotfix.
Priya (Inference): That explains it — v3.2-compact's tool adapter expects args.metadata.{source,ttl}. New model variants must be mapped to the unified tool adapter or we need argument coercion.
Alex (Support): Customer impact: some of their flows include third-party tool invocations; they see ~25% of requests failing intermittently. They're asking for ETA and rollback.
Maya (CS): Customer is asking to pause the rollout and route them back to v3.1 for now.
Priya (Inference): Suggested immediate mitigations: 1) Pause the rollout (stop new canary ramps) 2) Add a routing rule to pin AcmeRequests merchant/tenant to model v3.1 3) Patch adapter to accept missing metadata (short-term). I'll prepare a patch.
Jordan (SRE): I can pause the rollout and add a tenant pinning rule now. Doing: `POST /admin/route/pin` with tenant=acme -> model=v3.1. Will post result when done.
deploy-bot: Rollout pause requested by Jordan initiated at 02:45 UTC. Canary ramps frozen.
Jordan (SRE): Pinning rule applied, traffic for tenant acme now pinned to v3.1. Confirmed 200 OK from routing API.
Sam (Oncall): Please try the repro again, Maya/Alex.
Alex (Support): Re-tested with customer's payload against production tenant (post-pin) — successful 200 and tool invoked. Customer confirmed immediate improvement.
Maya (CS): Customer replied: "Thanks, seeing success again. Please advise on long-term fix."
Priya (Inference): Long-term: update router policy to ensure compatible tool adapters across fallback variants and include schema compatibility checks in our rollout gating. I'll open an RFC and a tracking ticket. Short-term: I'll deploy adapter patch in ~2 hours to accept missing metadata keys gracefully.
Alex (Support): I'll send the customer a summary and ETA.
Priya (Inference): Action items: (a) Priya create fix PR (b) Jordan keep rollout paused until adapter patch lands and passes e2e (c) SRE/QA run a small canary with compatibility tests.
Maya (CS): Thanks all. I'll update customer and close the escalation once patch is live. :thumbsup:
Alex (Support): Recording notes in the incident tracker: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-042.
Priya (Inference): Adding a short repro we used for engineers:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/chat \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \
  -d '{"model":"v3.2","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"search price of widget"}],"tools":[{"name":"web_search","args":{"q":"widget price"}}]}'
```
Expected: successful tool invocation. Observed (before pin): 400 schema error.
Jordan (SRE): logging note: adding routing diff to the rollback audit.
Maya (CS): Marking this resolved for customer follow-up; will reopen if they see regressions after canary resumes. :eyes:
